data.title: First Atlantic Nickel & Cobalt Raises 6.15 Million Dollars in No-Warrant, Non-Brokered Private Placement to Accelerate Mining Exploration and Development at Pipestone XL Nickel-Cobalt Alloy (Awaruite) Project in Newfoundland

data.title: Hamilton Reserve Bank Continues Pristine Compliance History, Wins 2026 IDC FinTech Real Results Award
data.description: In New York, Hamilton Reserve Bank (HRB), the top global bank in the Caribbean area, has been awarded the prestigious 2026 IDC FinTech Real Results Award in partnership with Temenos. HRB boasts US $25+ billion in custodial assets and deposits, with offices globally and serving clients from 150 countries in 126 currencies and 15 languages. This award recognizes their success in collaboration with Temenos, a leading banking technology firm powering 80% of the world's largest banks with efficient and secure core banking software.

data.title: IDACORP, Inc. Increases Common Stock Dividend
data.description: IDACORP, Inc. revealed that its Board of Directors sanctioned a rise in the regular quarterly cash dividend on IDACORP’s common stock to $0.90 per share, amounting to an annual indicated dividend of $3.60 per share. The company has consistently increased dividends yearly since 2011, marking a total dividend growth of 200% and a compound annual growth rate of 7.6% since then. Such increment underscores the company's commitment to rewarding shareholders.
